messages:
ryan: Heads-up — we're seeing intermittent 5xx spikes from the eu-west1 dedicated pool affecting long-prompt generations (embed/rerank paths). SLA alerts firing. Need a hotfix pushed asap. Artifact: sha:abcd1234. Can we fast-track and skip the regular canary window?
deploy-bot: DeployBot notice: rollout request received for artifact sha:abcd1234 to pool eu-west1. Canary required by policy (2m window). Automated health checks: failed threshold = 0.8% errors in 60s. Approvals required: 2 approvers from eng/sre.
sophie: I'm +1 for expedited rollout. This is impacting customer-facing latency and failing some demo flows. Recommend staged traffic: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 2m validation steps.
katie: +1 from product side — prefer shorter cutover but staged. Also add a metrics alert for tokenizer 5xx > 0.5% to auto-roll back.
ops-oncall: I can take the monitoring watch. Before we skip canary, confirm rollback criteria and the rollback command. Also need a link to release notes or quick changelog.
ryan: Rollback plan: revert to sha:9f0e7aa1, command `deploybot rollback --artifact sha:9f0e7aa1 --pool eu-west1`. Rollback trigger: sustained 5xx > 0.7% for >120s OR latency p50 > 600ms for 3 continuous minutes. Quick changelog: "fix: tokenizer buffer overflow on long context -> prevents out-of-bounds that caused 5xx" — small patch, no schema changes. Release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/sha/abcd1234/changelog
ivan: Suggest we also set `--traffic-split 10,30,100 --pause 120s` so the DeployBot performs the pauses. If deploybot doesn't support that, we'll run manual increments.
michelle: Oncall ack. I approve expedited if we keep staged traffic and auto-rollback thresholds in place. I'll watch traces and be ready to run the rollback command.
ryan: tagging the approvals: @sophie +1, @katie +1, @michelle +1. That's 3 approvers — proceeding to start.
deploy-bot: Approval recorded: sophie, katie, michelle. Policy check: approvals >=2 satisfied. Canary bypass flag detected: `--skip-canary` present? no. Suggested CLI to execute (copy/paste):

```
deploybot rollout --artifact sha:abcd1234 --pool eu-west1 --traffic-split 10,30,100 --pause-secs 120 --monitor-metric tokenizer_5xx --rollback-threshold 0.7
```
ryan: running the rollout now.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: sha:abcd1234 -> eu-west1. Stage 1: 10% traffic. Health checks in progress.
michelle: seeing initial metrics — 5xx spike down to 0.3% already. Traces look normal for the patched path.
deploy-bot: Stage 1 -> HEALTHY. Advancing to Stage 2: 30% traffic.
ops-oncall: monitoring logs and error budget. Setting an alert channel to #incidents/ops-watch.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> HEALTHY. Advancing to Stage 3: 100% traffic.
ryan: finished. Application metrics stable. Kicking off post-deploy smoke tests: `scripts/smoke/eu-embed-check.sh` now.
michelle: smoke passing. Watching for 10m. If anything crosses rollback thresholds I'll call for rollback and execute the command.
ivan: small note for postmortem — add the artifact diff and the exact failing stack traces to the ticket if we have them.
ryan: thanks all — marking as expedited hotfix complete for eu-west1. Will open an incident ticket with timeline and attach traces.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: sha:abcd1234 -> eu-west1 at 6778904402. No automated rollback triggered.
